_doc: GROWTH-1: the product manager's job is growth, not only bug fixes (owner directive 2026-11-12). This file is what the product manager loop reads: the share of shipped work that must be growth, the metrics that say whether the product is growing, and how work is classified. foundation/growth.py measures the mix and the metrics, publishes them on /live, and the executor prefers a growth item whenever the recent mix falls below the target. A growth item adds a capability, a surface, a reader or a customer path; a fix repairs something that was meant to work; maintenance keeps it running.
label: growth

metrics.what: human page views in the last 7 days (first-party, cookieless, bots excluded)
metrics.trigger: breach opens a growth item for the product manager

metrics.what: distinct visitors in the last 7 days
metrics.trigger: breach opens a growth item for the product manager

metrics.what: requests from bots and agents in the last 7 days (discovery documents, MCP, llms.txt)
metrics.trigger: breach opens a growth item for the product manager

metrics.what: views of the pilot application page in the last 7 days
metrics.trigger: breach opens a growth item for the product manager

owner_note: Targets are first hypotheses chosen by the system: the baseline measured on 2026-11-12 (1310 page views, 564 visitors, 817 agent hits, 326 pilot page views in 7 days) plus 15 to 25 percent. The product manager revises them from measured baselines, each change as a reviewed PR.
